author: pirat_nation
text:
France has approved a proposal for a new €0.055 tax per GB of internet traffic, and game downloads could be affected.

If GTA 6 ends up being around 218 GB, downloading it could cost €12 in tax under the proposal.

The tax could also affect other big game downloads and streaming services like Netflix and YouTube.

However, it’s not law yet. The proposal still needs to pass through the remaining legislative process in France.
